querystring.select: SELECT UMH.UPLOAD_MONITORING_NO AS UploadMonitoringNo, UMH.FILE_NAME AS FileName, UMH.TOTAL_RECORD AS TotalRecord, UMH.TOTAL_RECORD_PROCESSED AS TotalRecordProcessed, UMH.TOTAL_RECORD_ERROR AS TotalRecordError, RS.DESCR AS UploadStatus,UMH.MR_UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE AS UploadStatusCode ,UMH.ERROR_MESSAGE AS ErrorMessage
querystring.from: FROM dbo.UPLOAD_MONITORING_H UMH WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.UPLOAD_TYPE UT WITH(NOLOCK) ON UT.UPLOAD_TYPE_ID = UMH.UPLOAD_TYPE_ID JOIN dbo.REF_STATUS RS WITH(NOLOCK) ON RS.REF_STATUS_CODE = UMH.MR_UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE
